name: Lee Zhuyuan
source:
Lee first met Lucia in middle school and has been close friends with her ever since. Although, it seems like his feelings for her surpass that of friendship. In fact, he seems to have a little obsession towards her.

Lee is the son of a rich family and is the one next in line to inherit the family name. He is the student council president and is one of the smartest students of Valudeto High, being ranked #1. Being the "perfect" student, Lee is quite popular at school, and his relationship with Lucia can sometimes be one of the reasons as to why some girls are hostile towards Lucia.
